explanation: I did not find this result in Mathlib. The theorem is about the library's own (Foundation/LO) machinery for arithmetized provability: `Theory.Provableₐ`, the coding `⌜σ⌝`, `Derivation2`, and models of `𝐈Sg1`. Mathlib has no formalized proof predicate or Gödel-coding of derivations. The proof uses only the library's own lemmas (`provable_of_provable`, `Derivable.of_ss`, `theory_subset_AddR₀`), so no Mathlib declaration carries its content. No search was needed, since none of these concepts exist in Mathlib.
